approved_claims: Connect Google Calendar to let Life Manager add travel blocks for eligible in-person events
Life Manager calculates travel time and departure time from available event location and route information
Life Manager does not read Gmail
The seven-day free trial requires a payment method, then renews at USD 29 per month until canceled
Events without a sufficiently resolved location are left unchanged rather than guessed
margin_rule: Use verified Stripe invoices and refunds; subtract Stripe fees, route and Composio usage, hosting, and attributed marketing spend once. Keep unmeasured costs unknown.
audiences: Japanese commuters who check Calendar and Maps repeatedly to avoid arriving late
People traveling to appointments, meetings, classes, and events with changing locations
